description:
Crofton's formula measures a curve's length by counting intersecting lines. This video explains the formula, its application in Euclidean and hyperbolic geometry, and its extension to holographic kinematic space.

Report sources:
https://arxiv.org/html/1505.05515#S1.SS1
https://arxiv.org/html/1505.05515#S1.SS2
https://arxiv.org/html/1302.5790
thumbnailPrompt: A vivid illustration of a curve intersected by lines in a plane, with a mix of Euclidean and hyperbolic geometries, and a hint of holographic principles in the background.
title: Crofton's Formula: Measuring Curves by Counting Intersections
